<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_946454_food_de_0.GetMenuDetails</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GetMenuDetails</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GetMenuDetails = Class.create();
GetMenuDetails.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

    /**
     * Fetch menu details from the menu_items table
     * @param {String} restaurantName (optional)
     * @returns {Array} menuDetails
     */
    getMenuItems: function(restaurantName) {
        var menuDetails = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_946454_food_de_0_menu_items'); // Change this to your actual table name

        if (!gs.nil(restaurantName)) {
            gr.addQuery('restaurant_name', restaurantName); // Adjust field name if needed
        }

        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            menuDetails.push({
                name: gr.getValue('name'),
                description: gr.getValue('description'),
                price: gr.getValue('price'),
                ingredients: gr.getValue('ingredients'),
                restaurant: gr.getValue('restaurant_name')
            });
        }
        return menuDetails;
    },

    type: 'GetMenuDetails'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-07 09:45:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>0f175956836e6e10410a73d6feaad34b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GetMenuDetails</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Food Delivery System" source="x_946454_food_de_0">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Food Delivery System">d660a9d183ea2a10410a73d6feaad3a7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0f175956836e6e10410a73d6feaad34b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-07 09:53:39</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
